note: Only swaps the summarize button colors to warning CSS variables; the summary-state subscription stays in the memoized card, no child component extracted.
Replaces a CSS highlight workaround with a PropertiesTable highlightVariant prop; the local time-toggle state is not moved into the kea logic.
Automation now owns a single OneToOne task; each run reuses that task via _get_or_create_automation_task and creates a new task run instead of a new task.
Replaces Utc::now with a detected_at derived from the notification UUIDv7 timestamp for both the spike row and exception_timestamp; not taken from event properties.
Moves integration lookup, selected integration, channel value, member count, disabled reason and change handlers from the component into eventStreamLogic.
Deletes the bundled model.ubj, makes an S3 URI mandatory for the scorer, and adds an upload_surfacing_model management command plus S3 docs.
Removes the consumption flow from the setup skill, renumbers setup/maintenance flows, and moves consumption guidance into querying-posthog-data.
Deletes close_and_drain, close_dispatchers_and_drain and drain_after_senders_closed; exposes one public drain that callers invoke after dropping their handles.
Switches delete_property to @validated_request with the serializer, reads validated_data, and removes the inline duplicate validation.
Feedback handler now calls context.trackEvent with an AnalyticsEvent constant instead of capturing directly via the PostHog client.
Adds an _expire_change_request helper (expire, save, log, notify on commit) and uses it in both the pending and stale-approved branches.
Renames all tracing MCP tools from tracing-spans-* to an apm-* namespace (apm-trace-get, query-apm-spans, etc.) and updates generated definitions.
Hoists inline classes/helpers to module level and adds SSH tunnel parsing in the stream reader; the commented sweeper still reads raw job_inputs dict keys.
Replaces split level/users actions with a team config viewset whose list returns the whole config and create does a partial serializer update; not via Retrieve/Update mixins.
Drops the interestingness_score column from sessions v3 and adds a surfacing_score column and migration on session_replay_events.
Replaces the person and distinct-id batch workers with a generic run_batch_worker parameterized by a prepare fn and an async execute closure.
Adds a shared compile_ai_observability_hog helper in hog.py with null-safe comparisons and uses it from evaluations, taggers, and run_hog_eval.
Renames the module semaphore to messaging_clickhouse_query_semaphore and adds a get_messaging_client context manager that acquires it.
Moves the promote/demote org-scope logic out of the table component into a toggleTemplateOrganizationScope action in dashboardTemplateEditorLogic.
Gives section an optional permits argument and routes stats_snapshot through it with no permit, removing the open-coded Off check and direct offload.
